title: aj.pack
description: a fabric pack based on exploration and building. built for both creative and survival players in mind.
body:
a fabric 1.20.1 pack based on exploration and building. built for both creative and survival players in mind. I love exploring, but sometimes vanilla minecraft can get a bit repetative, so my main goal for this mod pack was to find mods that compeltly switched up terrain and structure generation. The terrain generation is completely overhauled with Terrailith and there are numerous structure mods included that make traveling and exploring worth it. They also can offer some challenge when it comes to overworld exploring. There are numerous types of dungeons with unique builds and a variety of spawners. New dimensions are added and old ones are revamped. This pack also includes mods that add new decorations, furniture, and blocks for the builders. One of my favorite things about mod pack is the amount of new blocks they add, so I made sure to include lots of new items and blocks. With mods like Wings and Mythic Mounts you are able to travel and build easier and faster. There is also several food mods that add more ways to cook and more things to eat. There is a lot to find and uncover with the mods included in this pack. Not only is there mods that add content their are also some that enhance gameplay. Everything from performance, sound, textures, and memory usage is taken care of. The game should run smoother then ever. Look forward to enchanced visuals from shaderpacks included. Features: - Terralith terrain gen - Numerous structure mods (new structures & revamped old ones) - New blocks for building - New elytra type from Wings - Several food mods for more variety when it comes to keeping you health and saturation high - New mobs (passive & aggressive) - Waystones - End Portal mechanics changed with End Remastered - Old mob vote creatures - Shaderpacks Thank you to all the devs for creating these mods!
